scripts.check: vp check apps/server apps/web/src packages/api/src packages/db/src packages/env/src packages/ui/src/components packages/ui/src/lib tests .github docs && vp run -r check-types
scripts.test:coverage:backend: vp test run --hookTimeout=30000 --coverage --coverage.reportsDirectory=coverage/backend apps/server/src/app.test.ts packages/db/src/index.test.ts packages/api/src/routers/cards.test.ts packages/api/src/cards/domain --coverage.include=apps/server/src/app.ts --coverage.include=packages/api/src/routers/index.ts --coverage.include=packages/api/src/routers/cards.ts --coverage.include=packages/api/src/cards/**/*.ts --coverage.include=packages/api/src/context.ts --coverage.include=packages/db/src/index.ts --coverage.thresholds.lines=60 --coverage.thresholds.statements=60 --coverage.thresholds.functions=60 --coverage.thresholds.branches=60
scripts.test:coverage:frontend: vp test run --project react --coverage --coverage.reportsDirectory=coverage/frontend tests/components/controls.test.tsx tests/components/stories.test.tsx apps/web/src/features/cards apps/web/src/lib --coverage.include=packages/ui/src/components/button.tsx --coverage.include=packages/ui/src/components/input.tsx --coverage.include=apps/web/src/features/cards/**/*.tsx --coverage.include=apps/web/src/features/cards/**/*.ts --coverage.include=apps/web/src/lib/*.ts --coverage.exclude=**/test/** --coverage.thresholds.lines=80 --coverage.thresholds.statements=80 --coverage.thresholds.functions=80 --coverage.thresholds.branches=80
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage:frontend && npm run test:coverage:backend
scripts.test:ci: npm run check && npm run guard -- --base main --checks explicit-any,architecture,test-hygiene,financial-conventions,test-companion,complexity,contract-regression,coverage-policy && npm run test:coverage
